definition_zh: 创制以人物为中心的纪传体史书体例，将本纪（帝王）、世家（诸侯）、列传（人物）、书（典章制度）、表（年月世系）五体合一，打破编年体局限，建立以人物命运为主线的历史叙事框架。
definition_en: Create a biography-centered historiography system combining five genres: Annals (emperors), Hereditary Houses (nobles), Biographies (individuals), Treatises (institutions), and Tables (chronology), overcoming chronicle limitations and establishing a historical narrative framework centered on human destiny.
source_chapter: 《史记·太史公自序》《汉书·司马迁传》
process_zh: 确定历史叙事的核心是人物而非事件
设计五体结构：帝王本纪、诸侯世家、人物列传、典章书、年代表
建立以人物命运为主线的历史发展脉络
通过人物群像展现历史变迁和社会结构
process_en: Establish human character rather than events as narrative core
Design five-genre structure: imperial annals, noble houses, biographies, treatises, chronological tables
Create historical development trajectory through character destinies
Show historical change and social structure through character portraits
key_quote_zh: 究天人之际，通古今之变，成一家之言
key_quote_en: Investigate the relationship between heaven and man, understand change through all ages, and establish one's own school of thought

definition_zh: 探究天道自然规律与人事社会发展之间的辩证关系，建立历史哲学维度，理解历史发展中的必然性与偶然性、规律性与能动性的统一。
definition_en: Explore the dialectical relationship between natural heavenly principles and human social development, establish historical philosophical dimensions, and understand the unity of necessity and contingency, regularity and agency in historical development.
process_zh: 分析历史事件中的自然因素与人为因素
识别历史发展中的规律性趋势和偶然性事件
理解天道与人事的互动关系
建立历史发展的哲学解释框架
process_en: Analyze natural and human factors in historical events
Identify regular trends and偶然性 in historical development
Understand the interaction between heaven and human affairs
Establish philosophical explanatory framework for historical development
key_quote_zh: 究天人之际，通古今之变
key_quote_en: Investigate the relationship between heaven and man, understand change through all ages

name_en: Understanding Historical Change Through Ages Method
definition_zh: 纵向贯通上下三千年历史，横向囊括政治、经济、文化、军事等多领域，识别历史演进规律，建立完整的历史发展观。
definition_en: Vertically connect three thousand years of history, horizontally encompass politics, economy, culture, military and other domains, identify historical evolution patterns, and establish a comprehensive view of historical development.
source_chapter: 《史记·八书》《史记·十二诸侯年表》
process_zh: 建立完整的时间跨度概念，理解历史连续性
从多维度分析历史发展的复杂性和多样性
识别历史发展的周期性和阶段性特征
总结历史演进的基本规律和模式
process_en: Establish comprehensive time span concept and understand historical continuity
Analyze complexity and diversity of historical development from multiple dimensions
Identify cyclical and阶段性特征 of historical development
Summarize basic laws and patterns of historical evolution
key_quote_zh: 通古今之变，成一家之言
key_quote_en: Understand change through all ages and establish one's own school of thought

name_en: Good Narration Rather Than Creation Method
definition_zh: 传承历史记载的规范和传统，尊重史实，不随意创作和虚构，保持客观中立的史学态度，以传承历史真相为首要任务。
definition_en: Inherit historical documentation standards and traditions, respect historical facts, avoid arbitrary creation and fiction, maintain objective and neutral historiography attitude, with preserving historical truth as primary task.
source_chapter: 《史记·太史公自序》《汉书·司马迁传》
process_zh: 严格考证历史资料的真实性
区分史实与传说、观点与事实
保持客观中立的叙述立场
遵循历史记载的规范和传统
process_en: Strictly verify authenticity of historical materials
Distinguish between facts and legends, views and facts
Maintain objective and neutral narrative position
Follow documentation standards and traditions
key_quote_en: Good at narration rather than creation

name_en: Writing in Anger and Perseverance Method
definition_zh: 将个人苦难和挫折转化为创作动力，忍辱负重，坚持完成历史使命，以'文王拘而演周易，仲尼厄而作春秋，屈原放逐乃赋离骚'的精神激励自己。
definition_en: Transform personal suffering and setbacks into creative motivation, endure humiliation and persevere to complete historical mission, inspired by the spirit of 'King Wen imprisoned and created the I Ching, Confucius in distress wrote the Spring and Autumn Annals, Qu Yuan exiled composed the Li Sao'.
process_zh: 将个人遭遇转化为创作动力
在逆境中保持创作热情和毅力
以历史使命感激励自己克服困难
通过创作实现个人价值和社会价值
process_en: Transform personal experiences into creative motivation
Maintain creative enthusiasm and perseverance in adversity
Inspire oneself to overcome difficulties through historical mission
Achieve personal and social value through creation
key_quote_zh: 文王拘而演周易，仲尼厄而作春秋，屈原放逐乃赋离骚
key_quote_en: King Wen imprisoned and created the I Ching, Confucius in distress wrote the Spring and Autumn Annals, Qu Yuan exiled composed the Li Sao

definition_zh: 深入挖掘历史真相，探究事物的本质和深层原因，钩深致远，通过细致的史料考证和逻辑分析还原历史本来面目。
definition_en: Deeply explore historical truth, investigate the essence and deep causes of things, delve deep and reach far, restore the original face of history through detailed historical material research and logical analysis.
source_chapter: 《史记·货殖列传》《史记·游侠列传》
process_zh: 收集和考证各种历史资料
分析历史事件背后的深层原因
通过逻辑推理还原历史过程
探究历史现象的本质和规律
process_en: Collect and verify various historical materials
Analyze deep causes behind historical events
Restore historical processes through logical reasoning
Explore essence and patterns of historical phenomena
key_quote_en: Explore the profound and hidden, delve deep and reach far

definition_zh: 以个体命运映照时代变迁，通过生动的人物描写和故事叙述展现历史，建立史家主体性，使历史叙述具有人文关怀和文学价值。
definition_en: Reflect historical changes through individual destinies, show history through vivid character descriptions and story narratives, establish historiographer subjectivity, and make historical narration possess humanistic care and literary value.
source_chapter: 《史记·项羽本纪》《史记·刺客列传》
process_zh: 选择具有代表性的历史人物
通过人物命运展现历史变迁
运用文学手法增强历史叙述的感染力
建立史家的独立思考和判断
process_en: Select representative historical figures
Show historical changes through character destinies
Use literary techniques to enhance historical narrative appeal
Establish historian's independent thinking and judgment
key_quote_zh: 究天人之际，通古今之变，成一家之言
key_quote_en: Investigate the relationship between heaven and man, understand change through all ages, and establish one's own school of thought
